limitations: Models are bound to actual content. Supplied scalar, CDF and PDF answers are parsed and compared to independently integrated statement models.
REVIEWED distinguishes author review of a sign/domain, sketch or written argument from symbolic checks; this is not external peer review.
Finite sampling is not used as a proof of density non-negativity. Rounded numerical quantiles are checked by bracketing the target probability.
Short checking covers the complete requested coefficients, polynomial branches, exact values and support endpoints. Arbitrary logarithmic or exponential formula entry is not added.
